title: The vendor-derived WCD937x driver (LineageOS sm6150 kernel)
by: LineageOS, from Qualcomm's GPL audio techpack
takes: Bring-up: supplies, a reset pulse, 5 ms for enumeration, then bind; the reset is touched only at bind and on DSP restart; nothing in headset detection touches reset, supplies or SoundWire. Insertion debounce 256 ms (mainline uses less).

title: modem/tqftpserv: upgrade and add patches for rsize & seek option handling (pmaports !4747)
takes: A modem's file transfers with rsize and seek options need a tqftpserv that handles them; it made the modem work on two close Qualcomm phones (sm6350, qcm6490).

title: Xiaomi POCO X3 NFC (xiaomi-surya) - device wiki page
takes: What the community reports working, part by part. The address is as the claims recorded it, to be confirmed as the current wiki.

title: Programmable voice (a number that answers and plays a tone)
takes: A telephone number driven by a program can answer a test call and play a known tone - a fully automatic call check without a second phone.

title: Xiaomi's GPL kernel for surya: the WCD937x node
takes: Supplies: L10A rxtx and px and BOB mic bias always on, L15A buck only on demand; micbias 1-3 at 2.7 V; a plain 3.5 mm jack with both MBHC switches set (hphl-swh, gnd-swh), no USB-C audio switch.

title: Xiaomi's GPL kernel for surya: the LPASS pin states
takes: The SoundWire pins' functions (TX data1 gpio19 func3, data2 gpio20 func2, RX data gpio22/23 func2) - mainline's corrected table agrees; the WCD937x reset is gpio24, active state driven high, sleep state low.
